title: The Hunt for Red October
note: mentioned during Breaking Away, Bill says they will do The Hunt for Red October if they do Inside Moves; mentioned again during Minority Report, Bill says "it's on the list"; mentioned again on other eps, most recently Species; mentioned again during Secario, CR says it needs to happen in October
plot: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub, the Red October, is heading for the U.S. coast under the command of Captain Marko Ramius. The American government thinks Ramius is planning to attack. Lone CIA analyst Jack Ryan has a different idea: he thinks Ramius is planning to defect, but he has only a few hours to find him and prove it - because the entire Russian naval and air commands are trying to find Ramius, too. The hunt is on!
